note: Why intermittent: workspace folders get a recursive directory watcher, which does observe the rename, so in-workspace files usually reload. Files opened outside any workspace folder are watched individually and reproduce it every time — e.g. plan files under ~/.claude/plans/, which the user reads while the agent edits them.
